name: dezire-more-admin-app
description: Native Android/iOS wrapper for the Dezire More admin panel (dezire-backend/admin-panel.html), via Capacitor. Kept as its own project — separate from the main storefront app's Capacitor setup at the repo root — since this is a genuinely different app: a different appId (com.deziremore.admin), a different audience (the store owner/admin, not customers), and no shared web build step (www/index.html is a checked-in copy of admin-panel.html, not something Vite builds).
